concepts.def: Two successive divisions producing four haploid gametes from one diploid cell; halves chromosome number.
Exchange of segments between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes at chiasmata in prophase I.
Random orientation of bivalents at metaphase I yields 2^n combinations (n=23 in humans).
Failure of homologues or chromatids to separate; causes aneuploidy (e.g., trisomy 21 in Down syndrome).
Photographic display of all chromosomes arranged in homologous pairs by size and banding.
Chromosomes of same length, centromere position and gene loci; one maternal, one paternal.
